title: Four-Pane Pilgrimage V3

sources.creator: Jason Roberts / Buried Signal
sources.access: Official site returned HTTP 502 in web reader; supplied survey record read in full.

transformation: The four-picture composition, independent pan/zoom, arrangement and stacked image-layer correspondence become a living ink folio. Four original lantern motifs drift continuously and change scale. A physically manipulated acetate window must stay registered with each motif to sustain the illuminated pilgrim path. Nonperiodic seeded trajectories require timely correction during the journey.
assets: Original canvas vector scenes, lantern geometry, sigils, procedural hatching and layout. No commercial art, level, code, soundtrack or media copied into the game.
third_party_runtime: Existing shared benchmark runtime only; no added dependency.
quality_status: prototype_visual_candidate; human calibration and downstream model difficulty unmeasured

construction_revision.reason: Preparation-conditioned nominal schedules solved 47/50 D1 seeds at revision 0.1; broaden lower-level travel-time variation and tighten D1 registration while retaining its one-axis, one-lantern problem
